monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLC Global share-to-win event has officially ended -- Winners revealed JLC Global share-to-win event has officially ended -- Winners revealed Press Release Jul 12, 2025 Our share-to-win event has officially ended and we are now in the data collection phase. The list of winners and corresponding links will be announced after the statistics are finalized and will be publicly displayed for 5 days . Once confirmed, we will contact the winners to arrange prize distribution. As of July 11, we have completed the data collection and ranking for all participants. Entries that violated the rules or appeared to involve cheating have been removed. To protect user privacy, only partial information and related data will be published. If a participant qualifies for two different awards, only the higher-ranking one will be granted, and the other will be passed down to the next eligible participant. Here are the winners of this event: 1. Best Exposure Award (based on total views): 1st Place: fan******* — 3.7M total views across all platforms 2nd Place: del************ — 3.6M total views across all platforms 3rd Place: new******** — 160K total views across all platforms 2. Best Engagement Award (based on likes + comments + shares + saves): 1st Place: ed****************** — 89,403 total engagements across all platforms 2nd Place: 3in********* — 42,424 total engagements across all platforms 3rd Place: diy******** — 10,524 total engagements across all platforms The results will be publicly displayed for 3 days . If you have any questions regarding the data, please send an email to marketing@jlcpcb.com . After the public notice period ends and no objections are raised, we will contact the respective winners to arrange the prize distribution.
